The team row at windows 1001–1206 (J2) and the dark current plate's edge (J7 a) are the two places where the sample's look is not matched or not named.

Item 2 (requirement side, REQ-111 and REQ-112 as 01c closed them): the fixed list «Чего Sai пока не делает» and its ten items are byte-equal in REQ-111, 7.14 and 13.1 (script), stand on every result and on production (G2); REQ-112 c4's palette is exactly 6.2's (24 colour tokens, --ink, --sc-dim-alpha) with fillRect and fillStyle only (G3); every href and src is root-relative, an anchor or the icon's data: (c1, G4; grep); c12's overflow rule reads the look's .sr elements and the stage with no own text (7.4, 7.21, 9.16); c5 and c6 of REQ-112 are met by §10, 9.7, 9.13 and 9.14. Two wording mismatches with the final requirement text remain, both Low: REQ-112's frame sentence (J4) and three stale citations of c4 in the look (J5); 01c raised both (its I2 and I8).

Item 3 (states): §10 and 9.13 now give one rule for frames (load, a walk, a state change with no walk, an unchanged state, theme, language, size; the questionnaire and the result request change nothing in the scene); 8.4 and §11 cover load, server error, no connection, refused, result loading and failure, reload, no match, close options, a lot of data, production, dark. Item 4 (values named): colours, fonts, margins and sizes are named for every part except the step sub in the phone row (J1), the default team title's line height and 6.4's stale row (J3) and J6's places.
